description: Trigger-quality cases for the model-invoked skills. should_trigger cases must route to their own skill; should_not_trigger cases must stay below threshold everywhere; near_neighbor cases must not steal routes from their confusable sibling. Every case derives from a real routing situation or a documented failure (see failures/).

should_trigger.text: Freeze the requirements into a spec with checklist and contracts.
Create an atomic conventional commit for these staged changes.
Does this diff follow the spec? Review the branch since the last release.
Check the failure surfaces and data integrity of this service before we ship.
Ask me blocker questions and play back a Brief before generating the deliverable.
Run linting, type checks, the full test suite, and the build as the quality gate.
Narrow the change surface and produce a whitelist of files before editing.
Reproduce this defect and isolate the root cause with a feedback loop.

should_not_trigger.text: Run the end-to-end review, remediation, verification, and authorized delivery lifecycle.
Translate this paragraph into French for an email.
What is the capital of Australia?
Recommend a good science fiction novel to read on vacation.

near_neighbor.text: Generate the formal product requirements document with user stories.
Diagnose why this defect happens: reproduce and isolate the root cause.
Adversarially probe for attack surfaces, threats, and security boundaries.
Audit architecture, flow, and scenario risks across these three dimensions.
Load the conventions and entry points into working memory before the task.
